title: 'More and more disenchanted': A final check-in on Trump's economic approval ratings before midterms
summary:
President Trump's economic approval ratings are hovering at second-term lows, with inflation worries the central headwind for the president and his party as the midterm elections loom.
A raft of recent polls underscores this reality: Trump's low overall approval ratings are being dragged down by economic sentiment that is even lower.
A new national poll released on Sunday by NBC News found that a majority of Republicans — 53% — say they are dissatisfied with the state of the economy.
The president is facing a negative net rating of -29.7% on trade and -31.1% on the economy overall, according to Silver, with this economic drag outpacing Trump's overall net approval rating of -22.6%.
One possible glimmer of hope for Republicans in that data: 20% of voters say they are either unsure or that neither party would do a better job.

title: Elon Musk pumps $446m into US midterms, as campaign spending set to 'shatter' records
summary:
The US midterms campaign is set to be the most expensive on record - with the total cost projected to reach nearly $12bn (£9bn), according to Open Secrets, an independent organisation that tracks campaign finance.
Most of the spending is driven by outside political groups - known as Super Political Action Committees (Super Pacs) - pouring large sums of money into some key races ahead of election day on 3 November.
The top individual donor is billionaire businessman Elon Musk, who has spent almost half a billion dollars backing Republican candidates, particularly in Texas where many of his companies are based.

title: DoorDash enters the restaurant value wars with a $12 meal deal
summary:
DoorDash is getting into the meal deal game.
The delivery service is offering $12 meal boxes in "select areas across more than 20 cities" including Atlanta, Chicago, and Philadelphia, it said on Monday.
"Meal Boxes are designed to drive a steady stream of everyday orders and introduce restaurants to new customers," DoorDash said in its statement.
Many customers have continued to order food for delivery while cutting their spending in other areas, despite added costs such as delivery fees and tips.
DoorDash's $12 boxes might be an acknowledgment that some diners are seeking budget-friendly options and convenience simultaneously.

summary:

title: What you need to know about the Election Day Voter Poll
summary:
What you need to know about the Election Day Voter PollA person holds an "I Voted" sticker in the town hall in Bangor, Maine, during early midterm voting, October 16, 2026.
The Voter Poll will also help explain what issues were important in the election and how important demographic groups voted.
The Voter Poll starts by contacting likely voters just before Election Day using multiple methods, including online, mailed postcards, text message, email and phone calls.
Pre-election respondents who have not voted at the time of their initial response are recontacted starting at 5 p.m. local time the day before Election Day through poll closing time in each state on Election Day.
On Election Day there is a strict embargo on any data coming from the early waves of the Voter Poll until 5 p.m.
